Description

Wipe down your countertops, shelves and more with the 6-Pack of Multi-Surface Microfiber Cleaning Cloths from up&up™. This pack of six microfiber cleaning cloths includes cloths in various colors with different textures and patterns. Plus, they have hanging loops for easy storage and are machine washable for convenient cleaning.
